reviews.text: Clear Expectation Pool Care deserves every bit of praise for their exceptional service. Their team is highly professional, knowledgeable, and always ensuring our pool is in perfect condition. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Chance Gardner

reviews.text: Clear Expectations does a great job on my pool week over week! They are always extremely thorough and ensure my pool is set for summer so we can enjoy it without worry. I would highly recommend them to anyone in need of pool care as they have been the best we have found in DFW.
reviews.author: Donna Johnson

reviews.text: Great experience! My pool was horribly green from a prior pool company and they were able to turn it around quickly for a fair price. They sent me emails to tell me what they were doing to my pool and weekly updates. Thank you Vincent for your hard work in making my pool swimmable in time for summer. Highly recommend them for fixing your green pool and weekly service, as I kept them on after they fixed it and have been very satisfied.
reviews.author: Jeffery Johnson

reviews.text: I am not a customer nor will I ever be. One of their service people drove a truck well into my yard. Claimed it was an accident - maybe. In any case they had an interesting approach to this: 1) removed the signs from the truck 2) towed it out of the yard. 3) never said a word to us nor even left a note. Had my son not seen the truck stuck in the yard we would not have known who the culprit was. All that I asked was to have the ruts fixed. 1 person with a shovel and a rake could have fixed this in 10 minutes. 6 weeks later and I have had ZERO action from them. This is probably indicative of their overall trustworthiness - beware.
reviews.author: Tim Sullivan

reviews.text: I used Clear Expectations for my pool remodel (replaced old plaster, tile and coping) and am thrilled with the outcome! They were responsive to my questions and asks, provided multiple options, showed me samples, and completed the job on time! They even included pool service for 60 days and I will absolutely be keeping them afterwards as the pool looks great and is summer ready! It was a great experience, and I will gladly use them in the future for any other remodels/repairs I need done.
reviews.author: Candice Hawks

reviews.text: The customer service and care the technicians show are amazing! We were able to schedule regular cleanings, they also repaired cracks in the pool. And they weren't pushy about it! Made it an easy decision to go with them! Definitely recommend!!
reviews.author: Kelsea Paul

reviews.text: Clear Expectations Pool Care and it’s technicians are highly skilled and knowledgeable. Their proficiency and expediency in cleaning and maintaining pools, as well as attending to service calls, are top notch! We highly recommend them to anyone in the DFW area, whether they are looking for pool cleaning, pool equipment maintenance or replacement, and even designing or remodeling of pools. They can do it all and offer competitive prices!
reviews.author: John Bitzer

reviews.text: Clear Expectations Pool Care has been wonderful to work with. They identified a crack in my pool that I hadn’t even noticed and were able to repair it in a timely manner.
reviews.author: Ana Villalobos
